A timeline of historical events that have taken place within Rinascita.

==Pre First Lament==
==Post First Lament==
*In the ancient era, Rinascita is known as the '''Realm of a Thousand Islands'''.<ref>[[A Transgressor's Transcript]]</ref>
**Well-versed in the ocean, the [[Fisalia Family]] extracts toxins and medicines from deep-sea plants, harnesses vast underwater resources, and revels in great fortune and widespread renown during this era.

*[[Riccioli Islands]] is ruled by a mysterious sailor who was driven from his homeland. He built a citadel that brought the people peace and prosperity, only to vanish without a trace. 
**According to legend, he left his most cherished treasures on the island before sailing off to pursue revenge. <ref>[[The Sailor's Treasure]]</ref>

*The Genesis Nexus, a type of Resonance Nexus, existed on Rinascita before it was settled. <ref>[[The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes]]</ref>

*The civilization of the archipelago is threatened by [[the Lament]] and [[Waveworn Phenomenon|Waveworn disasters]], and a group of displaced refugees board a mass of ships known as the Ark and embark on a quest to find new civilization. The trip is hazardous, but the Fisalia family, one of the founders of the Ark, is guided safely by an unknown voice and the light of the Genesis Nexus, leading the fleet to a lush archipelago. One of these islands later become [[Ragunna]].
**The refugees are of vastly different backgrounds, cultures, ideologies.
**Due to relentless disasters and geological distance, the nation remains isolated from the rest of the world for many years.

*The rulers of Rinascita gather in [[Fagaceae Peninsula]] for secret councils, and carve Oracles in the stone and trees.

*To the people, there exists not one but two divinities in the land, one ruling the skies, the Sentinel [[Imperator]], and the other ruling the seas, the Threnodian [[Leviathan]]. These two are eternally at odds with each other, and the people wage wars against each other over their different faiths.
**The Fisalia Family lays the deep-sea faith foundation of the Order as a means of securing the stability of their family's power over Ragunna. However, they are defeated in a war between them and another faction, and they are driven out. [[Thessaleo Fells]] is their domain, and the [[Porto-Veno Castle]] belongs to them.

*The [[Dark Tide]] ravages a great part of Rinascita. To save Ragunna, Imperator splits off portions of Their own power. However, this weakens the Sentinel, allowing the Threnodian to corrupt and merge with Their body, becoming a single hippocampus-like entity.
**One portion of Imperator's power is sealed within [[Tyrvine]], the sword later used to select their [[Resonator]]. 
**The other portion is the Remnant Spark, entrusted to [[Napoli II]], the first Primus of the [[Order of the Deep]]. This is in the form of a lantern, which grants him the power to strengthen Echoes to fight Tacet Discord as well as purify the Dark Tide. 
**The ruins of ancient Ragunna are located beneath the sea of clouds in [[Nimbus Sanctum]], with the exception of its highest spire, which is now the [[Atrium of Reflections]]. <ref>[[Lonely SOL-3: The Complete Guide to Ragunna]]</ref>

*Upon reaching the end of the Dark Tide in his pilgrimage, Napoli II discovers the true nature of the Threnodian. However, the Sentinel's power fails to shield him from its influence, and although he physically survives, his soul does not. While the two Divinities fight for dominance in their shared form, he commits many misdeeds against his own people.
** Shortly after the Dark Tide ends, he arranges a private meeting with the head of the Fisalia family. He entrusts them with the truth as well as Tyrvine before asking them to kill him.
** According to an ancient tablet, he tells his believers that the Sentinel, once whole, has been rent by warring beliefs, and the Dark Tide is born from Their wounds- however, a [[Cartethyia|Blessed Maiden]] will become the 'Enlightened One', and the Divinity will return to its true form, and Rinascita will then be free of suffering.

*Following Napoli II's death, the Order of the Deep elects a new Primus, and the spread of the faith surpasses previous reach. However, a dark mist corrupts their doctrine and changes everything regarding the Sentinel, including its statues, anecdotes, and proverbs.
**Only the Fisalia Family heads and the forebearers of the Ark know the true appearance of the Sentinel.

*The Fisalia family loses control over the Order of the Deep, and members begin experiencing strange nightmares involving a shadow of a giant fish beneath the sea. Many members leave the family, becoming devout believers of the Order, or moving to the seaport to distance themselves from other forces.

*The original tradition of the [[Pilgrim's Sail]] is established as an honorable act of devotion to the Sentinel. All who embark on the journey are devout, but it is said that only those blessed by the Sentinel return with the promised glory and honor. Historically, the number of survivors is vanishingly small. <ref>[[Former Privy Councilor's Notes]]</ref>
**Due to the high cost of the pilgrimages, the Order places a heavy tax on the commoners.

*In order to destroy Leviathan, Imperator enacts a plan involving the creation of an entity known as "Fleurdelys", who will exist as a shared artificial Resonator, as well as a search for a Blessed Maiden, a Resonator of Their own. <ref>[[The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier]]</ref>
**The plan, if successful, will violate the fundamental law that entities such as Sentinels and Threnodians can only have one Resonator, and result in the destruction of Imperator, Leviathan, and Fleurdelys.

*Following the Dark Tide, Septimont chooses to follow a different path than Ragunna, rejecting the Sentinel and instead championing human strength.

==Recent History==
* The [[Riccioli Islands]] maintain independence from the governance of the Order of the Deep throughout the years, and continue to preserve the customs from the Age of a Thousand Islands.

*After centuries of failure, Leviathan succeeds in the creation of [[Cartethyia]] through Imperator's return pod. 
**Leviathan plants Cartethyia with a human family in [[Egla Town]], falsifying their memories of her being their biological daughter.
**One of Leviathan's other failures, [[Mya]], is created during the same time period. She is also raised by humans in Ragunna.
*Promising an elixir that can grant any wish, the previous head of the Fisalia family oversees the trials to find the Blessed Maiden, who will become Imperator's Resonator.
**Candidates to become the Maiden attempt to resonate with Tyrvine while [[Overclocking]]. Since this is a dangerous process, Imperator tries to minimize the deaths by splitting the excess energy resulting from Overclocking. This energy takes the form of memory fragments scattered within [[Avinoleum]].

* The [[Montelli Family]] plays an instrumental role in charting trade routes that connect Ragunna, as well as Rinascita, to the wider world. As the island opens it maritime routes, the family rises to prominence, amassing great wealth and influence. They build the [[Averardo Vault]] to store their wealth. 
**Ships laden with their spices and minerals sails across the world, and in return, foreign treasures and wealth flows back to Rinascita.
**The Montelli Family also takes the lead in introducing and developing Reserved Terminals across Ragunna, securing the Order's approval to develop in secrecy, offering guarantees of safety and hefty tax payment in exchange.
**[[Carlotta]] is adopted by [[Francesco Montelli]] and becomes the Montelli Family's Executor.

*A faction within the Fisalia Family finds the Montelli Family's actions to be a direct affront to Imperator's teachings, and begin opposing them through various means.
**On one rainy night, the Fisalia Family raids the Montelli headquarters, costing many lives. <ref>[[If On a Rainy Night a Family]]</ref>
**10 years after this event, Carlotta finds and executes the man responsible for orchestrating the raid. <ref>[[Carlotta/Backstory#Character Stories]]</ref>

*[[Fenrico]] attends the Order's seminary as a student, and spoke passionately there of an ideal, dream world.

==Rover's Departure==
*'''~20 years before LD''' — Leviathan attempts to use [[Mya]] (who has moved to Septimont to become a Gladiator) to find Septimont's Central Hub and corrupt the Beacon system. Mya commits suicide by stabbing herself and jumping into the sea in order to hinder Leviathan's plans.
** Mya's body is pulled from the sea by [[Julia Silva]] and given to [[Cristoforo]]. He and the Fractsidus study Mya in Septimont's sewer system for the next 20 years to gain insights into Leviathan's powers.
*'''20 years before LD''' — Cartethyia unknowingly leads Ragunna as a false Blessed Maiden and Sentinel Resonator, and Leviathan feeds off of the people's worship of her. This eventually culminates in the Second Dark Tide on the day that Cartethyia was to be crowned as the Enlightened One, and appointed with her holy name, Fleurdelys. The Dark Tide erupts in the [[Avinoleum]], which was originally located on the islands of [[Beohr Waters]]. The Second Dark Tide is stopped by Fleurdelys, who chooses to oppose the Threnodian. 
**Fleurdelys splits Avinoleum from the island and raises it into the sky to isolate the Dark Tide's spread.
**[[Cantarella]] resonates with [[Tyrvine]] soon after the rise of [[Avinoleum]] to become the true Blessed Maiden. Imperator intends for her to accept the power of the Second Awakening, which would have killed Imperator, Leviathan, and Fleurdelys, as a Sentinel is only allowed to have a single resonator at a time, and Imperator and Leviathan have merged to become one entity. Fleurdelys' death would be collateral damage as she was the the existing Resonator for the merged entity. However, upon witnessing a vision of Fleurdelys fighting against Leviathan, Cantarella refused to accept the power, splitting it from herself and returning it to Imperator, who used the boost in power to provide an opportunity for Fleurdelys to slay the corrupted Sentinel.
** The Threnodian attempts to assimilate with Fleurdelys next, and in order to buy herself time, she splits herself into two beings. Both of them are sealed within Avinoleum.
** As a result of the Dark Tide, the Order is forced to abandon their seminary, later known as the Seminary of the Forgotten, as the sea of clouds floods it, reducing it to ruins before spreading to Ragunna.
**A seminary teacher and his student attempt to retrieve an artifact passed down by the sages, also referred to as a 'relic of the Ancient One'. The student alone is able to retrieve the relic, discovering that it is a sword, but does not manage to escape with it. <ref>[[Veils Off in Sun or Shadow]]</ref>

*'''20 years before LD''' — Fenrico leads Ragunna as Primus in the aftermath of the Dark Tide. Despite knowing Fleurdelys is the Threnodian's Resonator, he believes he must keep the truth to himself, cleanse the aftermath of the Dark Tide, and lead the people to pursue a pure and united will. <ref>[[What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing]]</ref>
**He calls himself the new Enlightened One in Fleurdelys' absence, an unprecedented title for a Primus to take.
**The Order immediately restricts the festivities of the Carnevale, publicly stating they are doing so to mourn the Holy Maiden.
**The practice of the Pilgrim's Sail is halted for 10 years. The tax placed on the commoners to fund the tradition is also lifted.

*'''20 years before LD''' — A group of artists and researchers unexpectedly uncover a hidden piece of the Order's history, and are hunted down in the name of preserving stability. The Montelli family rescues them by offering to lock them inside the Averardo Vault. They voluntarily choose this imprisonment, hoping that they can one day return.<ref>[[Silent as a Falling Leaf]]</ref>
** Within the next 20 years, all of the prisoners die, though their Reverberations remain in vault.

*'''~20 years before LD''' — [[Lorelei]] is molded by the Sentinel and commanded to restrain the clouds and prevent the [[Remnant]] Energy within from dissipating. Performing this duty, she resides in the [[Nimbus Sanctum]]. 

*'''~20 years before LD''' — The Marino family helps the Order Orphanage survive the worst of the Dark Tide.
** Later on, their ship is attacked by Tacet Discord while on route to [[New Federation]], and they do not survive. Their assets are liquified to offset the costs of sunken cargo, and their child, [[Phoebe]], is sent to live at the Order Orphanage. <ref>[[Phoebe/Backstory#Character Stories|Phoebe/Backstory]]</ref>

*'''<20 years before LD''' — A group of explorers recover an Acolyte's body from the Seminary of the Forgotten, as well as the relic, but any records on it have been lost to the Dark Tide. Upon inspection, the sword appears to have been crafted for Carnevale rituals rather than for combat, and is believed to have once belonged to a Primus.

*'''10 Years before LD''' — The last annual Carnevale is brought to ruin as a monstrous sea beast, rogue Echoes, and Tacet Discords sweep through the festival. 
**The Primus calls this a divine punishment, and the Carnevale is banned for the next 10 years.
**This festival marks the last record of the Sentinel.

*'''~10 years before LD''' — Following the Carnevale, Fenrico orders the reinstatement of the tradition of the Pilgrim's Sail, now as an act of punishment for violators of doctrine rather than one of faith.
**Although initially reserved for acts of blasphemy, it eventually includes even members of the Order who openly question Fenrico's decrees.
**The common people call this the 'Fool's Sails', ships filled with people who committed foolish acts. By extension, those who are sent aboard the Pilgrims Sails are also called 'Fools'.
**The [[Dragon of Dirge]] is taken control of by the Order, intending for it to kill those sent on the Pilgrim's Sail. To conceal the dragon's existence, the Order forbids any entry onto [[Penitent's End]].
**[[Brant]] survives the Pilgrim's Sail as a child after questioning the Sentinel's statue. He goes on to form the [[Troupe of Fools]], building [[Fool's Elysium]] with other survivors.
**[[Roccia]] is sent on the Pilgrim's Sail for performing a banned play. She is saved by [[Pero]] and taken in by the Troupe of Fools. <ref>[[Roccia/Backstory#Character Stories|Roccia/Backstory]]</ref>

*'''10 years before LD''' — The water level of Nimbus Sanctum begins to steadily rise, forcing the residents of [[Egla Town]] to move to the higher ground in the north.

*'''<10 years before LD''' — The members of Golden Anthem, a renowned Poets Society and the cantors of the Sentinel, encounter [[Cristoforo]] in [[Whisperwind Haven]], who leads them to a lithograph depicting Imperator's true form. They try to spread the truth, leading to their deaths upon the Pilgrim's Sail, as well as the tarnish of their reputation by the Order. <ref>[[Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest)]]</ref>
**They entrust the key to their study to the Toccata family, who continue their efforts to preserve the truth. However, each member is eventually sent aboard Pilgrim's Sail, with [[Ciaccona]] being the only survivor.
